name: Lazycraft AI – Content Generator, Writing Assistant & Image Editor
author: LazyCraft Studio

sections.description:
Lazycraft AI is an AI-powered content generation plugin for WordPress, designed to help users create high-quality articles, blog posts, and other content with ease. It also includes AI-powered image generation, an AI image editor for refining visuals, and team collaboration features to facilitate shared content creation.

With an intuitive step-by-step process, Lazycraft AI allows users to generate well-structured and engaging content based on their chosen tone, style, and topic. Whether you are a blogger, marketer, or business owner, Lazycraft AI streamlines the writing process, saving time while improving content quality.

Try the Pro Version | Documentation

Key Features

  • AI-driven content generation tailored to user input
  • Smart writing assistant that acts like your personal writing copilot
  • AI-powered image generation
  • Advanced AI image editor for refining and customizing images
  • Team collaboration features for shared content creation and editing
  • Notification system for team members
  • Content reviews and feedback
  • Approval workflow for content
  • Multiple AI models to choose from
  • Multiple writing tones and styles
  • Seamless integration with Gutenberg and Classic Editor
  • SEO-optimized content recommendations
  • Multi-language support for broader reach
  • And more…

Content Generator

Lazycraft AI features a robust AI-powered content generator that simplifies the process of creating well-structured, engaging, and high-quality text. Users can input their desired topic, select a tone and style, and let the AI generate content that is ready to be refined and published.

How It Works:

  • Open the Lazycraft AI Content Generator
  • Enter your topic or keyword.
  • Choose from various writing tones (e.g., professional, casual, persuasive) and styles.
  • Lazycraft AI will suggest a list of topics and styles based on your input.
  • Specify additional parameters, such as word count and section structure.
  • You can also add your own custom instructions to the AI.
  • Click Generate Content, and the AI will create a draft tailored to your preferences.
  • Edit, enhance, and refine the content before publishing.

This feature is perfect for bloggers, marketers, and businesses looking to create engaging content without spending hours writing manually. The AI-generated content is also optimized for SEO, making it easier to rank higher in search results.
Lazycraft AI empowers WordPress users to effortlessly create engaging and informative content without the need for extensive writing expertise.

Floating Writing Assistant

Lazycraft AI includes a floating writing assistant that provides real-time AI-powered suggestions while users write within WordPress. This feature helps improve content quality by offering:

  • Chat with the AI to get help with your writing
  • Joggle between Text & Image mode
  • Sentence rephrasing for clarity and engagement
  • Readability enhancements
  • Select text & apply custom instructions & prompts.
  • SEO keyword recommendations
  • Context-aware content suggestions

The floating assistant seamlessly integrates with both the Gutenberg and Classic Editor, ensuring a smooth and intuitive experience. Whether you’re crafting blog posts, landing pages, or product descriptions, this tool enhances your writing process by providing on-the-fly improvements without disrupting your workflow.
Lazycraft AI empowers WordPress users to effortlessly create engaging and informative content without the need for extensive writing expertise.

Advanced Image AI Editor

Lazycraft AI comes with a built-in AI-powered image editor that allows users to fine-tune and customize images effortlessly. You can use the floating manager to generate image using AI. Then use the advanced editor to modify images. This editor offers a variety of enhancement tools, enabling users to modify images generated by AI or uploaded manually. Features of the AI Image Editor include:

  • Fill in empty parts of the image with new content
  • Modify the image with text, shapes, and colors
  • Remove unwanted objects from the image
  • Automatic image enhancement for improved clarity and sharpness
  • Adjustable filters to create unique visual aesthetics
  • Cropping, resizing, and background removal tools
  • AI-powered touch-up features to improve image quality

The AI Image Editor integrates smoothly with WordPress, allowing users to edit images directly within the platform without needing external software. This feature is ideal for bloggers, eCommerce store owners, and content creators looking to enhance their visuals with minimal effort.

Team Collaboration : Feedback, Reviews & Approval

Lazycraft AI fosters an interactive and collaborative environment for content creation. Users can provide feedback, add comments, and review drafts within the WordPress editor, ensuring a seamless workflow for teams and content creators. Key collaboration features include:

  • Inline Comments: Team members can leave comments directly on specific sections of content for precise feedback.
  • Version Control: Keep track of changes and revisions with an easy-to-use version history.
  • Approval Workflow: Assign roles and permissions for content approval before publishing.
  • User Mentions: Tag specific users in comments to notify them of necessary updates or feedback.

These collaboration tools make Lazycraft AI a comprehensive solution for businesses, agencies, and teams managing content workflows in WordPress.

Notification System

Lazycraft AI includes a smart notification system that ensures users stay informed about important updates and team activities. This system enhances collaboration and content management by providing:

  • Real-Time Alerts: Receive instant notifications when team members leave comments or make updates.
  • Content Reminders: Get reminders for pending drafts, scheduled posts, and review requests.
  • AI Insights: Notifications for content optimization tips, SEO suggestions, and engagement insights.

This notification system keeps content teams aligned, improves workflow efficiency, and ensures timely content updates without the need for constant manual checks.

Why Use Lazycraft AI?

Lazycraft AI is the ultimate content creation tool for WordPress users who want to produce high-quality, engaging content with minimal effort. Here’s why you should choose Lazycraft AI:

  • Time-Saving Efficiency: Generate compelling content and images in minutes instead of hours.
  • SEO Optimization: Built-in AI-driven recommendations help improve content visibility and ranking.
  • Versatile Content Creation: Supports a variety of content types, including blogs, product descriptions, and marketing copy.
  • Seamless Workflow Integration: Works smoothly with Gutenberg and Classic Editor for a hassle-free writing experience.
  • Enhanced Collaboration: Share, review, and edit content with your team in real-time.
  • AI-Powered Enhancements: Leverage smart writing and image editing tools to polish your content effortlessly.
  • User-Friendly Interface: Simple, intuitive, and accessible for both beginners and advanced users.

Whether you’re a blogger, marketer, eCommerce store owner, or agency, Lazycraft AI streamlines your workflow and enhances content quality, making it the perfect AI-powered writing assistant for WordPress.

Try the Pro Version | Documentation

Feedback or Support

If you have any feedback or need support, please contact us. Or you can use the WordPress support forum to get help.

External services

Lazycraft AI uses the following external AI API services:
1. OpenAI – We are using the official OpenAI API to generate content and images. https://api.openai.com/v1/
2. Gemini – We are using the official Gemini API to generate content. https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/
3. LazyCraft API – LazyCraft API is used to generate high quality images. https://docs.lazycraft-ai.com/

These services are used to generate content and images, we don’t store any of your data on our servers and personal data is not shared with any third party API, however, your blog post content is sent to the AI services to generate content and images.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin from the WordPress repository.
  2. Install and activate the plugin.
  3. Configure the plugin settings in the WordPress admin dashboard.
  4. Start using the plugin to generate content and images.
sections.faq:
Can I use multiple AI models?

Yes, you can use multiple AI models. You can select the model you want to use in the plugin settings, or on the fly in the content generator or writing assistant.

Can I use my own API keys?

Yes, you can use your own API keys. You can enter your API keys in the plugin settings.

What AI providers are supported?

Lazycraft AI supports the following AI providers:
* OpenAI
* Gemini
* Claude (Coming Soon)

How do I get an API key?

You can get an API key from the AI provider’s website.
* OpenAI
* Gemini

How does the Image Editor work?

The Image Editor uses the AI to generate an image based on your prompt. You can then use the tools to modify the image. The image editor is based on a credit system. You can use the floating manager to generate images. Each image generation uses a certain number of credits.

How do I get image credits?

Each Pro user gets free credits depending on the plan they have. You can purchase more credits packs from the plugin site.

What the future holds?

Lazycraft AI is constantly evolving. We are working on adding more features and making the plugin more user-friendly.
